question: The shape of Basketball must be _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**spherical**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• The shape of a basketball is **spherical**, ensuring uniformity in its bounce, roll, and gameplay. 
• A spherical design provides a **smooth and round surface**, allowing consistent handling, dribbling, and shooting accuracy. 
• Basketballs are designed to meet **international standards** set by governing bodies like **FIBA** (International Basketball Federation) and the **NBA** (National Basketball Association). 
• The spherical shape ensures the ball rolls predictably and maintains its balance during play, which is crucial for professional and recreational games. 
• Other shapes such as **cylindrical, geoid, or conical** would cause erratic bouncing and movement, making them unsuitable for basketball. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 __ 
• **Specific Characteristics of Basketball:** 
• The **circumference** of a standard basketball for men’s games is approximately **29.5 inches** (75 cm), while for women’s games, it is **28.5 inches** (72 cm). 
• Basketballs are made of materials like **leather, composite leather, or rubber**, ensuring durability and grip. 
• The balls are inflated to a standard pressure, typically **7.5 to 8.5 pounds per square inch (psi)**, to maintain their spherical shape during play. 
• **Why Other Shapes Are Unsuitable:** 
• **Cylindrical:** Would lead to uneven bouncing and rolling, making it unsuitable for basketball gameplay. 
• **Geoid:** An irregular shape like Earth's would result in unpredictable movement and bounce. 
• **Conical:** Would not roll or bounce properly, creating challenges in dribbling and shooting. 
• **Historical Context:** 
• The basketball was first used in **1891** when **Dr. James Naismith** invented the game. 
• Initially, soccer balls were used, but later, spherical basketballs were designed specifically for the sport to ensure better control, bounce, and gameplay. 
• **Applications:** 
• Basketballs are used in professional leagues like **NBA, WNBA, and FIBA**, college games, and recreational play. 
• They are also employed in training sessions to develop skills like **dribbling, passing, and shooting**. 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 
• **FIBA Specifications:** 
• Official basketball size for men’s games is **size 7 (29.5 inches)**, while for women’s games, it is **size 6 (28.5 inches)**. 
• **Material Innovation:** 
• Modern basketballs use advanced materials like **microfiber composite leather** for enhanced grip and durability. 
• Some feature **moisture-wicking technology** for better performance in various conditions.
